credits.routing-purpose: Routing chooses the next flow step, not the reply wording.
credits.routing-methods: Smart Routing uses AI; fuzzy routing compares texts without AI.
credits.routing-replies: Both allow prewritten replies or optional AI-generated replies.
credits.title: Additional AI credits
credits.intro: Each plan includes monthly credits. If you need more, you will be able to buy a top-up inside Pautia, separately from your subscription.
credits.pack-note: We will publish the credit amount and package price before enabling purchases.
credits.separate-note: A top-up adds AI balance, not bots or storage. It is not included in the configurator price.
credits.usage-media: Also interpreting audio, images and documents, depending on your plan.
credits.usage-generated: Generating AI replies is optional and also uses credits.
credits.usage-written: Sending prewritten replies does not use AI credits.
credits.expiry-answer: Plan credits renew each month and do not roll over.
credits.expiry-topups: Top-ups accumulate and expire 12 months after each purchase.
credits.expiry-order: Credits closest to expiry are used first.
credits.empty-question: What happens when credits run out?
credits.empty-answer: Without a balance, AI features become unavailable.
credits.empty-features: This includes Smart Imports, Smart Routing and AI-generated replies.
credits.empty-media: You also cannot interpret audio, images or documents.
credits.empty-routing: You can choose fuzzy routing: it is free, but less accurate.
credits.empty-written: With prewritten replies, this option lets agents keep handling texts.
credits.empty-pause: You can also deactivate the agent until you top up AI credits.

campaigns.link: Learn its limits and the alternative of multiple agents
campaigns.title: Is Pautia suitable for mass campaigns?
campaigns.intro: No. Agents handle conversations and flows started by customers, not unsolicited bulk messages.
campaigns.limit-title: Each agent has a deliberate pace
campaigns.limit-one: Each agent sends one message at a time, with pauses. It cannot reply to many chats at once.
campaigns.more-agents: Add agents to serve more chats in parallel. Each keeps its controlled pace; this is not bulk messaging.
account-safety.link: How Pautia reduces the risk of blocking
account-safety.why: Avoiding instant replies, bursts and identical texts reduces abuse signals, not all risk.
account-safety.variants: Define varied replies to the same question. The agent picks from your approved variants.
account-safety.title: How we pace your account's activity
account-safety.intro: Agents aim for a human-like pace. These measures reduce risks but cannot prevent every block.
account-safety.pacing: Each agent sends one message at a time, with varying pauses, not to all chats at once.
account-safety.presence: When enabled, it can mark messages as read and show a typing indicator before replying.
account-safety.limits: Sending limits and per-contact pauses help avoid bursts and repeated replies.
faq.faq-answer.7: One use case. Manage in Pautia or connect your system via REST API or MCP for complex tasks.
